_comment: Evidence for the Bible text and word-for-word credits (audit items B8, B12, C7 and C10; founder's decisions 10, 11 and 19), 21 October 2026, branch af-bt off main 2aabdcc.

Each record gives the page or file that was read, its final address, the HTTP status, the UTC time it was fetched, the SHA-256 of the body as fetched, and either the exact words (public domain, an openly licensed data file, or text the publisher requires the app to show) or a pointer to where on the page the fact is (copyrighted pages, whose words are not copied here).
pinned: a file of a source pinned in sources.json, read from the verified raw folder of that commit (its hash is the file's, not a web page's).
Checks are described, never who made them.

records.method: Each key gives, for every full code, its fields (line 1) and a phrase (line 2). web/src/ui/Pairs.tsx reads each code part by part with the keys' own words for its letters; '/' joins the parts of a Hebrew word and ' + G<number>=' the parts of a joined Greek word. Where TEHMC's phrases spell 'resultive/transtive', its own notes' spelling 'Resultative / Transitive' is used.
checked: Every grammar code in the built text was put in words and compared with the key's phrase, on 21 October 2026.

Hebrew and Aramaic: 3,083 distinct codes, made of 742 distinct parts; 734 parts give the key's phrase exactly (99.6% of the 469,294 parts in the text). The 8 that differ: HAcmsa and HAcmsc (1,953 parts), whose phrase says 'Adjective' though their own fields say 'Form=Numerical', given here as 'Numerical Adjective' like every other Ac code; HVPrmpa (6), whose phrase leaves out its voice; and 5 Aramaic codes (6 parts) where the phrase and the fields disagree. 14 words carry no code and get no tooltip.

Greek: 1,167 distinct codes; 1,098 give the key's phrase exactly, with a word the phrase repeats given once (138,690 of 142,096 words, 97.6%). The 69 that differ (3,406 words): PRT-N and PRT-I (2,905 words), whose phrases repeat their extra field ('Negative Particle Negative Negative'), given here once; 15 noun, particle and verb codes whose phrase leaves out a part of the code (Title, Individual, Location, Gentilic or 'Transcribed from Aramaic'), given here; 4 noun codes whose phrase says 'Individual Gentilic' where the key's other noun codes say 'Person Gentilic', given here as 'Person Gentilic'; 9 codes of 2nd Present, 2nd Perfect and 2nd Pluperfect verbs whose phrase drops '2nd', kept here; 29 possessive pronouns, whose phrase says '1st Person' or '2nd Person' and drops the owner's number, given here as '1st Singular', '1st Plural' and so on; V-PEP-ASM, V-RMM-2P and V-RMM-2S, whose phrases contradict their own codes (case or mood), read here from the code; 4 codes whose phrase puts the same words in another order; and A-DSF-T ('of a type'), V-RPP-GPF ('feminine' in small letters) and N-DPM-C (adds 'Gentilic'). No code is left without words.
The test and its full list of differences are kept outside the repository with the run's notes; it can be repeated from the two key files above and the built web/public/data/text/*.json.
